_about: Capability assessment, one record per cell, each with the evidence it rests on. The paper's Tables 4 and 5 are generated from this file by make_tables.py, so a cell cannot appear in the paper without an evidence string and a source. Assessed 2026-09-21. Citation keys are per-organisation; the specific source URL for each cell is appended to its reason, so consolidating the bibliography did not cost per-cell traceability.

rubric.Y: Native. The capability is available through a documented interface of the system as shipped, without reconstructing the graph outside it.
rubric.P: Partial. Available only under a material qualification, which the cell's reason states: connector-specific, bounded, requires joining a separately-governed store, or semantically narrower than the workload needs.
rubric.N: Absent. Not available through any documented or source-inspected interface examined.
rubric.-: Not applicable. The artefact defines no layer of this kind (OpenLineage specifies data, not a query surface).

Unity Catalog.version: Databricks docs 2026-09-21; recursive CTE requires DBR 17.0+

representation._caption: Metadata representation: does the system record the fact the workload needs?

Apache Atlas: Process entities relate input to output DataSets [https://atlas.apache.org/2.0.0/TypeSystem.html]

OpenLineage: columnLineage facet, DIRECT/INDIRECT with subtypes JOIN, FILTER, WINDOW [https://openlineage.io/docs/spec/facets/dataset-facets/column_lineage_facet]
Apache Atlas: ColumnLineageProcess arrives via the Hive bridge, not the core type system [https://atlas.apache.org/2.0.0/Hook-Hive.html]
Egeria: DataMapping maps a schema attribute of one asset to another (model 0770) [https://egeria-project.org/concepts/lineage/]
Unity Catalog: column_lineage has source/target_column_name, but lineage is not preserved across renames and events without a source are excluded [https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/data-governance/unity-catalog/data-lineage]

Apache Atlas: entity audit events retain prior states; no first-class schema-version entity [https://atlas.apache.org/2.0.0/ClassificationPropagation.html]
OpenMetadata: entity versioning major.minor; deleting a column is a major bump [https://docs.open-metadata.org/v1.12.x/connectors/ingestion/versioning]
Unity Catalog: information_schema.tables exposes LAST_ALTERED but no schema-version history [https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/sql/language-manual/information-schema/tables]

OpenLineage: Run is a first-class entity with nominalTime and errorMessage facets [https://openlineage.io/docs/spec/object-model]
Apache Atlas: hive_process records a transformation, not individual executions [https://atlas.apache.org/2.0.0/TypeSystem.html]
Egeria: Engine Actions record governance-action executions, not arbitrary pipeline runs [https://egeria-project.org/concepts/lineage/]
Unity Catalog: system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline carries workspace_id, job_id, run_id, period_start_time, period_end_time and result_state, and documents joins to system.lakeflow.jobs, billing.usage and compute.clusters on workspace_id/job_id/run_id. No join to system.access.table_lineage is documented. A table-to-job association does exist elsewhere: data_quality_monitoring.table_results.upstream_jobs carries job_id and workspace_id alongside the table identity, which are the documented join keys into job_run_timeline. Partial because that path requires anomaly detection to be enabled, covers only monitored tables, and its root_cause_analysis and downstream_impact structs are Beta [https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/admin/system-tables/jobs]

Apache Atlas: no data-quality model in the type system [https://atlas.apache.org/2.0.0/TypeSystem.html]
DataHub: Assertion entity, six types including FRESHNESS, with assertionRunEvent [https://docs.datahub.com/docs/generated/metamodel/entities/assertion]
Egeria: quality captured as discovery Annotations rather than declared assertions [https://egeria-project.org/concepts/lineage/]
Unity Catalog: system.data_quality_monitoring.table_results records freshness and completeness CHECK RESULTS per table (status, last_value, predicted_value), which corresponds to AssertionResult. There is no separate table of check DEFINITIONS, so nothing corresponds to QualityAssertion: anomaly detection is inferred from table history rather than authored, and is enabled per schema or catalog rather than declared per check. Checks are table-level (freshness, completeness); column-level checks are not offered, and completeness slicing by column group is Beta. Partial because result state exists but the assertion definition the model distinguishes does not, and the scope is narrower than the field-level assertions Q7 admits [https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/admin/system-tables/data-quality-monitoring]

OpenLineage: run timing exists, but no latency attributed to a lineage edge [https://openlineage.io/docs/spec/object-model]
DataHub: FRESHNESS assertions are per dataset, not per edge [https://docs.datahub.com/docs/generated/metamodel/entities/assertion]
Unity Catalog: Data quality monitoring reports commit freshness per table as predicted versus actual commit time, which is a per-table staleness signal, not a latency attributed to a dependency edge. Lineage rows carry event_time, not a hop latency, and run delay lives in a separate schema. Q4 needs a quantity on the edge so it can be accumulated along a path; none of these is that [https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/admin/system-tables/data-quality-monitoring]

OpenLineage: events are timestamped by emission; no validity interval [https://openlineage.io/docs/spec/object-model]
Apache Atlas: AtlasClassification declares validityPeriods, but AtlasRelationship carries no validity interval [https://github.com/apache/atlas]
DataHub: aspect versions record write order, not world validity [https://docs.datahub.com/docs/metadata-modeling/metadata-model]
OpenMetadata: lineageDetails carries createdAt/updatedAt, no validity window [https://openmetadatastandards.org/lineage/lineage/]
Egeria: InstanceProperties declares effectiveFromTime and effectiveToTime, and Relationship carries InstanceProperties, so edges are validity-dated [https://github.com/odpi/egeria]
Unity Catalog: no validity interval on lineage rows [https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/admin/system-tables/lineage]

OpenLineage: event emission time is recorded; retention is the consumer's concern [https://openlineage.io/docs/spec/object-model]
Apache Atlas: AtlasRelationship carries createTime, updateTime and a monotonic version [https://github.com/apache/atlas]
DataHub: versioned aspects plus timeseries aspects with timestampMillis [https://docs.datahub.com/docs/metadata-modeling/metadata-model]
Unity Catalog: event_time and event_date are recorded, but the lineage tables keep a rolling one-year window [https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/admin/system-tables/lineage]

expressiveness._caption: Query expressiveness: can the interface the system exposes state the operation?

OpenLineage: the specification defines no query layer [https://openlineage.io/docs/spec/object-model]
Apache Atlas: the current DSL grammar has no traversal production at all; Gremlin is used internally to execute DSL but is not exposed [https://github.com/apache/atlas]
DataHub: searchAcrossLineage and scrollAcrossLineage traverse multiple hops [https://docs.datahub.com/docs/graphql/queries]
OpenMetadata: the lineage API expands to a requested depth; the search API cannot traverse [https://docs.open-metadata.org/latest/how-to-guides/data-discovery/advanced]
Egeria: UltimateSource and UltimateDestination materialise the closure as relationships [https://egeria-project.org/concepts/lineage/]
Unity Catalog: WITH RECURSIVE over system.access.table_lineage joins source_table_full_name to target_table_full_name; requires DBR 17.0+, default limit 100 recursion levels and 1,000,000 rows [https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/sql/language-manual/sql-ref-syntax-qry-select-cte]

DataHub: direction parameter on the lineage queries [https://docs.datahub.com/docs/graphql/queries]
OpenMetadata: upstream expansion to a fixed depth [https://docs.open-metadata.org/latest/how-to-guides/data-discovery/advanced]
Unity Catalog: the same recursion with the join direction reversed; no separate construct is needed [https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/sql/language-manual/sql-ref-syntax-qry-select-cte]

Apache Atlas: DSL aggregates (COUNT, MAX, MIN, SUM) apply to a result set, with no path context [https://github.com/apache/atlas]
DataHub: lineage search returns reachable entities, with no per-path accumulator [https://docs.datahub.com/docs/graphql/queries]
Egeria: the closure is materialised as endpoints, so intermediate hops are not aggregable [https://egeria-project.org/concepts/lineage/]
Unity Catalog: a recursive CTE carries columns forward on each iteration, so an accumulator column summed down each branch is a path-local fold [https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/sql/language-manual/sql-ref-syntax-qry-select-cte]

Apache Atlas: the loop and withPath clauses of the pre-1.0 DSL are absent from the current grammar [https://github.com/apache/atlas]
DataHub: per-hop limits bound the search but do not select among paths [https://docs.datahub.com/docs/graphql/queries]
Egeria: ultimate source or destination is a form of path endpoint selection, but no shortest-path predicate [https://egeria-project.org/concepts/lineage/]
Unity Catalog: recursion depth is an ordinary column, so MIN(depth) or a window over it selects a shortest path [https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/sql/language-manual/sql-ref-syntax-qry-select-cte]

Apache Atlas: audit history is queryable, but not as a predicate inside a traversal [https://atlas.apache.org/2.0.0/ClassificationPropagation.html]
Egeria: the effectiveTime retrieval parameter selects by validity [https://egeria-project.org/parameters/overview/]
Unity Catalog: ordinary SQL predicates on event_time inside the recursive step [https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/sql/language-manual/sql-ref-syntax-qry-select-cte]

Apache Atlas: no traversal for a predicate to range over [https://github.com/apache/atlas]
DataHub: filters apply to the result set, not under the traversal [https://docs.datahub.com/docs/graphql/queries]
OpenMetadata: genuine negation operators (Not in, Not contain) exist, but over attributes with no traversal to range over [https://docs.open-metadata.org/latest/how-to-guides/data-discovery/advanced]
Egeria: no documented negation over a lineage closure [https://egeria-project.org/concepts/lineage/]
Unity Catalog: the recursive CTE materialises a result set, so NOT EXISTS against it applies negation under the closure [https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/sql/language-manual/sql-ref-syntax-qry-select-cte]
